_comment: Product-level IQVIA market overrides (2026-10-09, Ahmed: option B). Applied by refresh_iqvia.py AFTER the source rows are read and AFTER the corporate restatements, so a future IQVIA_SOURCE update (or a regenerated 'Market Mapping' sheet) cannot silently push these products back to OTHER MARKET. A row matches a rule when ALL given conditions match: products (exact Product name), molecule_contains (case-insensitive text in Molecule), doses (standard dosage form), period_from/period_to (YYYY-MM, inclusive). Matching rows get the rule's dm1 / dm2 / line / bu. Edit here, then re-run UPDATE_DASHBOARD.

overrides.why: IQVIA_SOURCE of 2026-10-09 mapped every lacosamide competitor to OTHER MARKET (row-majority mapping), leaving Epilosamide alone in LACOSAMIDE_MKT (~100% share). Market = all lacosamide tablets, all brands, all periods.
IQVIA_SOURCE of 2026-10-09 moved DOZOVA A KSM66 from ONLY_DOZOVA_ASHW to OTHER MARKET (CHC Zeta share fell 7.1% -> 4.4%).
The new 60-tablet pack of DOZOVA WOMAN MAX (Jul-Aug 2026) came in as OTHER MARKET.

2026-10-16 (Ahmed): adult esomeprazole sachets (20/40 MG) were in OTHER MARKET, so NEXICURE 20MG sachet could not be planned. New defined market for adult sachets; the paediatric ESOMEPRAZOLE SACHET market (2.5-10 MG, PEDIA) is unchanged. Brands today: NEXICURE 20MG, ESMORAP 20/40MG.

2026-10-26 (Ahmed): "Cluster - Launch Products Defined Market.xlsx". Kulyafin (CVM-I launch) market = C03A1 finerenone tablets, all brands, all periods. Brands today: FINOXLAB, KERENDIA. Kulyafin not yet in IQVIA.

2026-10-26 (Ahmed): "Cluster - Launch Products Defined Market.xlsx". Dozova Kids Max (PEDIA launch) = A11A2 paediatric MVIT+MIN, ordinary liquid (syrup / oral solution / suspension). Not yet in IQVIA.
2026-10-26 (Ahmed): "Cluster - Launch Products Defined Market.xlsx". Dozova Kids Drops (PEDIA launch) = A11A2 paediatric MVIT+MIN, oral drops. Not yet in IQVIA.
2026-10-26 (Ahmed): "Cluster - Launch Products Defined Market.xlsx". Dozova Kids Gummies (PEDIA launch) = A11A2 paediatric MVIT+MIN, gummies. Not yet in IQVIA.

2026-10-26 (Ahmed): "Cluster - Launch Products Defined Market.xlsx". Dozova Brain Boost (PEDIA launch, syrup) = the named C04A1 competitor brands, liquid forms only (capsule/tablet/ampoule/sachet packs of the same brands excluded), plus DOZOVA BRAINBOOST. Name mapping: Cerberoprove=CEREBROPROVE, Cenravita Colin=CENTRAVITA COLIN, Memo pUra=MEMO PURA.
